sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Itching ; falling off of hair ; roots of hair
painful. Pustules. Pair in occiput, extends to right
ciliary region. Deep seated pain in sides of head.

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Burning and itching in auditory canals. Ec-
zema behind ears.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Hay-fever begins with burning and itching
of palate and conjunctiva. Annoying itching in the
nostrils and roof of the mouth. [IVyethia.] Coryza;
loss of smell. [Va/. mur.] Sneezing, itching of nos-
trils.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Burning and itching; bleeding of gums.
Ulcers and exfoliations in the commissures. Fissures
in tongue.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Coldness in stomach. Longing for acids.
\Antim.; Ars.; China; Phos.]

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Movement as from something alive.
Flatulence, pain at pubic region.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Greenish. Burning at anus. Diarrhoea of
nursing children. [(7m;//.; Calc, phos.]

sections.label: Male
sections.text: Bain in spermatic cord after embrace.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses too early and profuse. Neuralgic
pains from face to shoulders and pubis. Desire with
vaginal pruritus.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
J3yspnoea ; cough ; bluish expectora-
tion. Burning and pain in nipples.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Itching, burning ; oedema of hands and
feet. Burning and swelling of soles. Copious and of-
fensive sweat of feet.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Eczema ; itching and crawling, especially of
chest, upper extremities. Fissures in fingers and heels.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : Anthoxantum — sweet ver-
nal grass (a popular medicine for hay-fever and coryza).
Lolium : Cepa; Sahad.; Silica.
